in_sanskrit.name: Pravendra
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pravendra एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Pravendra is derived from the Sanskrit word Praveñdrā, meaning 'Lord of the Gods'. This name is rich in meaning and symbolism, reflecting the strength and wisdom of the divine. It is a powerful and evocative name, ideal for a child who is destined for great things.
